authority: third_party/xedit/Edit Scripts/xEditAPI.pas -- xEdit's own Pascal declaration, shipped with the editor

known_conflicts.declared: procedure FileWriteToStream(aeFile: IwbFile; akOutStream: TStream);  -- xEditAPI.pas:334
known_conflicts.measured: passing two arguments raises [EJvInterpreterError] Not enough parameters (2026-09-30 23:47)
known_conflicts.rule: where the declaration and a shipped working script disagree, the working script is right and the declaration is stale

hierarchy_source: Tome of xEdit section 13.5. xEditAPI.pas declares the types flat with no parent links, so this is transcribed from the documentation and is the only place the nesting exists.

declarations.name: DataPath
declarations.doc: <summary>Provides the file path to the game's data folder as a String</summary>

declarations.name: ProgramPath
declarations.doc: <summary>Provides the file path to Tes5edit's installation folder as a String</summary>

declarations.name: ScriptsPath
declarations.doc: <summary>Provides the file path to Tes5Edit's 'Edit Scripts' folder as a String.</summary> <remarks>NOTE If launching TES5Edit via a .tes5pas file, ScriptsPath will change to the directory where the .te5pas file is located. (therefore if your script has any .pas file it is grabbing functions from, they also need to be in the that same directory.)</remarks>

declarations.name: FileCount
declarations.doc: <summary>Provides the number of loaded files in your current TES5Edit session</summary> <remarks>NOTE: "Skyrim.Hardcoded.keep.this..." (aka. Skyrim.exe) is considered a file and is reflected in this variable.</remarks>

declarations.name: wbAppName
declarations.doc: <summary>xEdit app name. Examples: 'TES5','TES4','FNV','FO3','FO4'</summary>

declarations.name: wbGameName
declarations.doc: <summary>xEdit game name</summary>

declarations.name: wbGameMasterEsm
declarations.doc: <summary>xEdit game master file name</summary>

declarations.name: wbVersionNumber
declarations.doc: <summary>xEdit version number.</summary>

declarations.name: AddMessage
declarations.doc: <summary>Pushes a line to TES5Edit's Information tab.</summary>

declarations.name: Assigned
declarations.doc: <summary>An extension to Delphi's native <see cref="System|Assigned"/> function: returns true if aeElement is not Nil, and returns false otherwise.</summary>

declarations.name: Assigned
declarations.doc: <summary>Delphi's native <see cref="System|Assigned"/> function: redefined here because Delphi doesn't support overloads of function from different modules.</summary>

declarations.name: ObjectToElement
declarations.doc: <summary>If you have stored an <c>IInterface</c> inside of a TList or TStringList, you must call this function when retrieving the object from the list, i.e. <c>ObjectToElement(myList.Items[0])</c>.</summary>

declarations.name: FileByIndex
declarations.doc: <summary>Find a file by index. See also: <see cref="xEditAPI|FileCount"/>.</summary>

declarations.name: FileByLoadOrder
declarations.doc: <summary>Find a file by load order.</summary>

declarations.name: FullPathToFilename
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the full path to the filename asFilename.</summary>

declarations.name: EnableSkyrimSaveFormat
declarations.doc: <summary>As of xEdit 3.1.2, calling this function will corrupt saved plugins until xEdit is restarted.</summary>

declarations.name: GetRecordDefNames
declarations.doc: <summary>Unverified: Modifies akList by adding entries based on the contents of the global wbRecordDefs.</summary>

declarations.name: JumpTo
declarations.doc: <summary>Scroll to an element in the xEdit window</summary>

declarations.name: wbFilterStrings
declarations.declaration: procedure wbFilterStrings (akListIn: TStrings; akListOut: TStrings; asFilter: String)
declarations.doc: <summary>Modifies akListOut, adding every entry in akListIn that contains the substring asFilter.</summary>

declarations.name: wbRemoveDuplicateStrings
declarations.doc: <summary>Modifies akList, removing any duplicate entries that it contains.</summary>

declarations.name: BaseName
declarations.doc: <summary>Identical to Name except that it handles IwbFiles differently. Name will prepend a load order index (i.e. [02] PluginName.esp), while BaseName will not.</summary>

declarations.name: BuildRef
declarations.doc: <summary>Builds reference information for the element and all of its descendants. Note that this function will run even if reference information has already been built.</summary>

declarations.name: CanContainFormIDs
declarations.doc: <summary>Guaranteed to return True if the element can contain form IDs, but not guaranteed to return False if it can't. This accesses an internal property, CanContainFormIDs, which the internal implementation of BuildRef uses to skip processing certain descendant elements.</summary>

declarations.name: CanMoveDown
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns true if the element is part of an array and can be moved further down using MoveDown.</summary>

declarations.name: CanMoveUp
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns true if the element is part of an array and can be moved further up using MoveUp.</summary>

declarations.name: Check
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the error message produced when the "Check for Errors" functionality is run on aeElement; or else an empty string if no error is found.</summary>

declarations.name: ClearElementState
declarations.doc: <summary>Manipulates the internal flags of an element, e.g. ClearElementState(eElement, esModified);. See also: GetElementState, SetElementState.</summary>

declarations.name: ContainingMainRecord
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the main record that contains the element.</summary>

declarations.name: DefType
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the def-type of the element.</summary>

declarations.name: DisplayName
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the display name of the element, if it has one; otherwise, this behaves identically to Name. See also: BaseName, ShortName.</summary>

declarations.name: ElementAssign
declarations.declaration: function ElementAssign (aeContainer: IwbContainer; aiIndex: integer; aeSource: IwbElement; abOnlySK: boolean): IwbElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Copy the contents of one element into a container element, or create and append an element to a container. aeContainer Destination element. aiIndex Where to place the new element, if the destination is an array. Specify HighInteger to append. Specify LowInteger or a negative value to add to non-arrays. aeSource Element to copy from. Use Nil to create a blank element of the appropriate type. abOnlySK Sorted Key Only; : Only apply to elements participating in container sorting, for internal xEdit usage. Use False. Sample: there is a script to copy VMAD subrecords "Skyrim - Copy VMAD subrecord.pas"</summary>

declarations.name: ElementType
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the type of the element. This is one of the following values: etFile, etMainRecord, etGroupRecord, etSubRecord, etSubRecordStruct, etSubRecordArray, etSubRecordUnion, etArray, etStruct, etValue, etFlag, etStringListTerminator,etUnion, etStructChapter.</summary>

declarations.name: EnumValues
declarations.doc: <summary>If aeElement is a set of named enum values, this function returns the names of any values that have been set, separated with spaces.</summary>

declarations.name: Equals
declarations.declaration: function Equals (aeElement1: IwbElement; aeElement2: IwbElement): boolean
declarations.doc: <summary>Compares two elements by their ElementID. This is sometimes necessary, as different IInterface variables pointing to the same element don't always compare properly when using the = operator.</summary>

declarations.name: FlagValues
declarations.doc: <summary>If aeElement is a set of flags, this function returns the names of all set flags, separated with spaces.</summary>

declarations.name: FullPath
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the full path to the element, going all the way down to its containing file. See also: Path, PathName.</summary>

declarations.name: GetContainer
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the element's container.</summary>

declarations.name: GetEditValue
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns a string representation of the element's value. See also: SetEditValue, GetElementEditValues, SetElementEditValues.</summary>

declarations.name: GetElementState
declarations.declaration: function GetElementState (aeElement: IwbElement; aiState: TwbElementState): TwbElementState
declarations.doc: <summary>Checks the internal flags of an element. See also: ClearElementState, SetElementState.</summary>

declarations.name: GetFile
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the file that contains the element.</summary>

declarations.name: GetNativeValue
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the element's value. See also: SetNativeValue, GetElementNativeValues, SetElementNativeValues.</summary>

declarations.name: IsEditable
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns true if the record can be edited. In some cases, xEdit will block edits to files like Skyrim.esm.</summary>

declarations.name: IsInjected
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns true if the element is an injected record.</summary>

declarations.name: LinksTo
declarations.doc: <summary>Obtains the referenced element. Not to be confused with ReferencedBy Elements. Call this function on any container element (etSubRecord) to get the iwbMainRecord of that form. (Ex: Calling LinksTo() on any 'LNAM - FormID' subRecord found in a FormID List will return the IwbMainRecord of that record).</summary>

declarations.name: MarkModifiedRecursive
declarations.doc: <summary>Marks the element and all of its descendants as modified. This forces xEdit to serialize them.</summary>

declarations.name: MoveDown
declarations.doc: <summary>If the element is part of an array, this function moves it down by one slot. See also: CanMoveDown.</summary>

declarations.name: MoveUp
declarations.doc: <summary>If the element is part of an array, this function moves it up by one slot. See also: CanMoveUp.</summary>

declarations.name: Name
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the name of the element, if it has one. If aeElement is an IwbFile or certain kinds of IwbMainRecords, Name will return a "pretty" name, while BaseName or ShortName will return a more basic string. See also: DisplayName.</summary>

declarations.name: Path
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the path component of aeElement -- that is, one single piece of the path that FullPath would return. You could use this when manually constructing a path to supply to ElementByPath. See also (and don't confuse with): FullPath, PathName.</summary>

declarations.name: PathName
declarations.doc: <summary>Similar to FullPath except that names in the path are prefixed with brackets, to uniquely identify each element's unique position among its siblings (see IndexOf). Example: \[02] neromancer.esp\[7] Worldspace\[1] World Children\[1] Children of 00000D74\[0] Persistent\[2] [REFR:00100452]</summary>

declarations.name: Remove
declarations.doc: <summary>Removes the element from its file.</summary>

declarations.name: ReportRequiredMasters
declarations.declaration: procedure ReportRequiredMasters (aeElement: IwbElement; akListOut: TStrings; akUnknown1: boolean; akUnknown2: boolean)
declarations.doc: <summary>Checks which master files aeElement depends on, and adds their filenames to akListOut. First boolean is Recursive to go over children elements if it is a container, second is Initial which is false by default.</summary>

declarations.name: SetEditValue
declarations.declaration: function SetEditValue (aeElement: IwbElement; asValue: string): string
declarations.doc: <summary>Sets the element's value to one that matches the string representation passed in. See also: GetEditValue, GetElementEditValues, SetElementEditValues.</summary>

declarations.name: SetElementState
declarations.declaration: function SetElementState (aeElement: IwbElement; aiState: TwbElementState): TwbElementState
declarations.doc: <summary>Manipulates the internal flags of an element. Returns the value prior to modification. See also: ClearElementState, GetElementState.</summary>

declarations.name: SetNativeValue
declarations.declaration: function SetNativeValue (aeElement: IwbElement; avValue: variant): string
declarations.doc: <summary>Sets the element's value. See also: GetNativeValue, GetElementNativeValues, SetElementNativeValues.</summary>

declarations.name: SetToDefault
declarations.doc: <summary>Resets the element's data and adds missing fields if any</summary>

declarations.name: ShortName
declarations.doc: <summary>Generally the same as Name unless aeElement is a reference, cell, or similar record. Name will return detailed information for those records, while ShortName will return the signature and form ID in the format [XXXX:01234567].</summary>

declarations.name: SortKey
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns a string unique to the element entered. This can be used for sorting elements or for comparing them; for example, you could compare the SortKey for two elements in records which override each other to see if they are different from each other.</summary>

declarations.name: wbCopyElementToFile
declarations.declaration: function wbCopyElementToFile (aeElement: IwbElement; aeFile: IwbFile; abAsNew: boolean; abDeepCopy: boolean): IwbElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Copies an IwbMainRecord, IwbGroupRecord, or IwbContainer to the specified file. The abAsNew boolean controls whether or not you're copying the record as an override record. Returns the copied element.</summary>

declarations.name: wbCopyElementToFileWithPrefix
declarations.declaration: function wbCopyElementToFileWithPrefix (aeElement: IwbElement; aeFile: IwbFile; abAsNew: boolean; abDeepCopy: boolean; akUnknown1: IInterface; akUnknown2: IInterface; akUnknown3: IInterface): IwbElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Details unknown. Returns the copied element.</summary>

declarations.name: wbCopyElementToRecord
declarations.declaration: function wbCopyElementToRecord (aeElement: IwbElement; aeRecord: IwbMainRecord; abAsNew: boolean; abDeepCopy: boolean): IwbElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Copies an element to a record, e.g. the "Conditions" element on a COBJ record or a faction from an NPC_ record. Returns the copied element.</summary>

declarations.name: Add
declarations.declaration: function Add (aeContainer: IwbContainer; asNameOrSignature: string; abSilent: boolean): IwbElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Creates a child element with the name-or-signature asNameOrSignature in aeContainer if no such child already exists; otherwise, marks the existing child as modified. Returns the created or existing element.</summary>

declarations.name: AddElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Adds aeElement as a child of aeContainer. Throws an error if aeElement already has a container.</summary>

declarations.name: AdditionalElementCount
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the number of "fake" elements xEdit adds before the "Record Header". For references it shows "Cell" for example. This getter accesses an internal function used internally for imposing some order on the sub-elements; it checks whether this element "counts," and if so, how many times. Seems to return 1 or 2 for (main?) records, and 0 for record fields (sub-records).</summary>

declarations.name: ContainerStates
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the internal container flags for aeContainer (e.g. whether it's initialized, or whether it has had references built) as a bitmask. Refer to "Worldspace browser.pas" for a usage example.</summary>

declarations.name: ElementByIndex
declarations.declaration: function ElementByIndex (aeContainer: IwbContainer; aiIndex: integer): IwbElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the aiIndex-th child element in aeContainer. See also: ElementCount.</summary>

declarations.name: ElementByName
declarations.declaration: function ElementByName (aeContainer: IwbContainer; asName: string): IwbElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Searches aeContainer for the child element with name asName, and returns the found element or Nil. See also: ElementExists.</summary>

declarations.name: ElementByPath
declarations.declaration: function ElementByPath (aeContainer: IwbContainer; asPath: string): IwbElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Searches aeContainer for the descendant element specified by path asPath, and returns the found element or Nil.</summary>

declarations.name: ElementBySignature
declarations.declaration: function ElementBySignature (aeContainer: IwbContainer; asSignature: string): IwbElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Searches aeContainer for the child element with signature asSignature, and returns the found element or Nil.</summary>

declarations.name: ElementCount
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the number of child elements in aeContainer. See also: ElementByIndex.</summary>

declarations.name: ElementExists
declarations.declaration: function ElementExists (aeContainer: IwbContainer; asName: string): boolean
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns true if aeContainer as a child element whose name is asName. See also: ElementByName.</summary>

declarations.name: GetElementEditValues
declarations.declaration: function GetElementEditValues (aeContainer: IwbContainer; asPath: string): string
declarations.doc: <summary>Finds the element within aeContainer specified by asPath, and returns a string representation of its value.</summary>

declarations.name: GetElementNativeValues
declarations.declaration: function GetElementNativeValues (aeContainer: IwbContainer; asPath: string): Variant
declarations.doc: <summary>Finds the element within aeContainer specified by asPath, and returns its value.</summary>

declarations.name: IndexOf
declarations.declaration: function IndexOf (aeContainer: IwbContainer; aeChild: IwbElement): integer
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the index of aeChild in aeContainer, or -1 if aeChild is not a child element of aeContainer.</summary>

declarations.name: InsertElement
declarations.declaration: function InsertElement (aeContainer: IwbContainer; aiPosition: integer; aeElement: IwbElement): integer
declarations.doc: <summary>Inserts aeElement as a child of aeContainer at the specified position.</summary>

declarations.name: IsSorted
declarations.doc: <summary>Checks whether xEdit always keeps aeContainer sorted. If so, this function will return True, and calling CanMoveUp and CanMoveDown on child elements will always return False.</summary>

declarations.name: LastElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the last child element in aeContainer, or Nil if there are no child elements.</summary>

declarations.name: RemoveByIndex
declarations.declaration: function RemoveByIndex (aeContainer: IwbContainer; aiIndex: integer; abMarkModified: boolean): IwbElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Removes the aiIndex-th child from aeContainer, and returns it.</summary>

declarations.name: RemoveElement
declarations.declaration: function RemoveElement (aeContainer: IwbContainer; avChild: Variant): IwbElement
declarations.doc: <summary>Removes avChild from aeContainer and returns the removed element. The avChild argument can be: the index of an element to remove from an array container; the name or signature of an element to remove; or an IwbElement to remove.</summary>

declarations.name: ReverseElements
declarations.doc: <summary>Reverses the order of the child elements in aeContainer.</summary>

declarations.name: SetElementEditValues
declarations.declaration: procedure SetElementEditValues (aeContainer: IwbContainer; asPath: string; asValue: string)
declarations.doc: <summary>Finds the element within aeContainer specified by asPath, and sets its value based on the string representation asValue.</summary> <param name="aeContainer">Container of elements</param> <param name="asPath">Path to element to change</param> <param name="asValue">Text value to set</param>

declarations.name: SetElementNativeValues
declarations.declaration: procedure SetElementNativeValues (aeContainer: IwbContainer; asPath: string; avValue: Variant)
declarations.doc: <summary>Finds the element within aeContainer specified by asPath, and sets its value using thte native asValue.</summary> <param name="aeContainer">Container of elements</param> <param name="asPath">Path to element to change</param> <param name="avValue">Variant value to set</param>

declarations.name: AddMasters
declarations.doc: <summary>Adds the list of masters in aMasters to aeFile. If sorting is desired an explicit call to SortMasters is necessary.</summary>

declarations.name: AddMasterIfMissing
declarations.declaration: procedure AddMasterIfMissing (aeFile: IwbFile; asMasterFilename: string; aSortMasters: Boolean = True)
declarations.doc: <summary>Adds the specified file as a master for aeFile, if it isn't already a master. If SortMasters is true (the default) all masters will be sorted if any were added.</summary>

declarations.name: AddNewFileName
declarations.doc: <summary>Creates a new, empty plugin in the game's plugin folder (Data) and adds it to the end of the plugins list.</summary> <param name="asFileName">Name of the plugin.</param> <returns>The reference to the newly created plugin as a IwbFile</returns>

declarations.name: CleanMasters
declarations.doc: <summary>Appears to find unnecessary files in aeFile's master list and remove them, updating all form indices accordingly. Don't confuse this within "cleaning master files" as in "removing ITMs and UDRs from official DLCs." This function is used in "Skyrim - Book Covers Patch.pas".</summary>

declarations.name: FileFormIDtoLoadOrderFormID
declarations.declaration: function FileFormIDtoLoadOrderFormID (aeFile: IwbFile; aiFormID: cardinal): cardinal
declarations.doc: <summary>Converts aiFormID from a form ID relative to aeFile's master list (like that returned by FixedFormID) to a load-order-relative form ID (like that returned by FormID). See also: LoadOrderFormIDtoFileFormID.</summary>

declarations.name: FileWriteToStream
declarations.doc: <summary>Writes the contents of aeFile to akOutStream. Used in "SaveAs.pas" to allow a user to save a loaded file under a new name; that script creates a TFileStream object and uses this function to write to it.</summary>

declarations.name: GetFileName
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns aeFile's filename.</summary>

declarations.name: GetIsESM
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns True if aeFile is flagged as an ESM. See also: SetIsESM.</summary>

declarations.name: GetLoadOrder
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns aeFile's index in the load order, or -1 if called on something that is not an IwbFile.</summary>

declarations.name: GetNewFormID
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns a new form ID, the same way that Add(..., ..., True) does.</summary>

declarations.name: GroupBySignature
declarations.declaration: function GroupBySignature (aeFile: IwbFile; asSignature: string): IwbGroupRecord
declarations.doc: <summary>If aeFile has a top-level group with the specified signature, that group is returned.</summary>

declarations.name: HasGroup
declarations.declaration: function HasGroup (aeFile: IwbFile; asSignature: string): boolean
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns True if aeFile contains a top-level group with the specified signature.</summary>

declarations.name: HasMaster
declarations.declaration: function HasMaster (aeFile: IwbFile; asMasterFilename: string): boolean
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns True if aeFile has a file with the name asMasterFilename as a master.</summary>

declarations.name: LoadOrderFormIDtoFileFormID
declarations.declaration: function LoadOrderFormIDtoFileFormID (aeFile: IwbFile; aiFormID: cardinal): cardinal
declarations.doc: <summary>Converts aiFormID from a load-order-relative form ID (like that returned by FormID) to a form ID relative to aeFile's master list (like that returned by FixedFormID). See also: FileFormIDtoLoadOrderFormID.</summary>

declarations.name: MasterByIndex
declarations.declaration: function MasterByIndex (aeFile: IwbFile; aiIndex: integer): IwbFile
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the aiIndex-th master file for aeFile.</summary>

declarations.name: MasterCount
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the number of master files that aeFile has.</summary>

declarations.name: RecordByEditorID
declarations.declaration: function RecordByEditorID (aeFile: IwbFile; asEditorID: string): IwbMainRecord
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the MGEF or GMST record in aeFile that has the specified editor ID. For all other record types, use something like MainRecordByEditorID(GroupBySignature(f, 'ECZN'), 'RandomEncounterZone1').</summary>

declarations.name: RecordByFormID
declarations.declaration: function RecordByFormID (aeFile: IwbFile; aiFormID: integer; abAllowInjected: boolean): IwbMainRecord
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the main record in aeFile that has the specified form ID, or Nil if no records match. The form ID must be local to the file (see FixedFormID).</summary>

declarations.name: RecordByIndex
declarations.declaration: function RecordByIndex (aeFile: IwbFile; aiIndex: integer): IwbMainRecord
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the aiIndex-th record in aeFile.</summary>

declarations.name: RecordCount
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the number of records that aeFile has.</summary>

declarations.name: SetIsESM
declarations.doc: <summary>Modifies the ESM flag for aeFile. See also: GetIsESM.</summary>

declarations.name: SortMasters
declarations.doc: <summary>Attempts to sort the masters for aeFile by their place in the current load order.</summary>

declarations.name: BaseRecord
declarations.doc: <summary>If aeRecord is a reference, this function returns the IwbMainRecord of its base form. Otherwise, the function returns Nil.</summary>

declarations.name: BaseRecordID
declarations.doc: <summary>Appears to return the load-order-relative form ID of aeRecord.</summary>

declarations.name: ChangeFormSignature
declarations.doc: <summary>Changes aeRecord's signature to asNewSignature. No other information is modified.</summary>

declarations.name: ChildGroup
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the group that aeRecord contains, if any. For example, a WRLD record will be followed by a GRUP containing the worldspace's CELLs, and you would use this function to retrieve that group.</summary>

declarations.name: CompareExchangeFormID
declarations.declaration: function CompareExchangeFormID (aeRecord: IwbMainRecord; aiOldFormID: cardinal; aiNewFormID: cardinal): boolean
declarations.doc: <summary>Attempts to change aeRecord's form ID from aiOldFormID to aiNewFormID, and returns True if the operation succeeds.</summary>

declarations.name: EditorID
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the record's editor ID.</summary>

declarations.name: FixedFormID
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the local FormID of the record. Local records will not have a load-order prefix (i.e. 0x00FFFFFF), and overrides will have a prefix relative to the record's file's masters. See also: FormID, GetLoadOrderFormID.</summary>

declarations.name: FormID
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the record's form ID. See also: FixedFormID, GetLoadOrderFormID.</summary>

declarations.name: GetFormVCS1
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the value of the Version Control Info 1 field. See also: SetFormVCS1.</summary>

declarations.name: GetFormVCS2
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the value of the Version Control Info 2 field. See also: SetFormVCS2.</summary>

declarations.name: GetFormVersion
declarations.doc: <summary>Get Form Version field from the record's header. See also: SetFormVersion.</summary>

declarations.name: GetGridCell
declarations.doc: <summary>If aeRecord is an exterior cell, this function will return its grid coordinates as a TwbGridCell; you can access the coordinates by checking returnValue.x and returnValue.y.</summary>

declarations.name: GetIsDeleted
declarations.doc: <summary>Checks the record's "deleted" flag. See also: SetIsDeleted.</summary>

declarations.name: GetIsInitiallyDisabled
declarations.doc: <summary>Checks the record's "initially disabled" flag. See also: SetIsInitiallyDisabled.</summary>

declarations.name: GetIsPersistent
declarations.doc: <summary>Checks the record's "persistent" flag. See also: SetIsPersistent.</summary>

declarations.name: GetIsVisibleWhenDistant
declarations.doc: <summary>Checks the record's "visible when distant" flag. See also: SetIsVisibleWhenDistant.</summary>

declarations.name: GetLoadOrderFormID
declarations.doc: <summary>Returns the record's form ID relative to the current load order. See also: FixedFormID, SetLoadOrderFormID.</summary>

declarations.name: GetPosition
declarations.doc: <summary>If aeRecord is a reference (or a subtype, like ACHR), this function will return its position.</summary>

declarations.name: GetRotation
declarations.doc: <summary>If aeRecord is a reference (or a subtype, like ACHR), this function will return its rotation.</summary>

declarations.name: HasPrecombinedMesh
declarations.doc: <summary>Checks whether aeRecord is a Fallout 4 reference that has precombined mesh data generated. See also: PrecombinedMesh.</summary>

declarations.name: HighestOverrideOrSelf

declarations.doc: <summary>If aeGroup is a child group, this function returns the main record that it is associated with. For example, a Dialogue Topic (DIAL) is followed by a group (GRUP) that contains its Infos (INFO); and passing that GRUP to this function would retrieve the DIAL. Cells (CELL) and Worldspaces (WRLD) have their contents set up similarly to Dialogue Topics, so this function will work with them as well.</summary>

declarations.name: ResourceContainerList

declarations.name: ResourceCopy
declarations.declaration: procedure ResourceCopy (asContainerName: string; asFilename: string; asPathOut: string)
declarations.doc: <summary>Retrieves the resource named asFilename from the resource container named asContainerName (see ResourceContainerList), and saves that resource to the specified file path asPathOut. The "Assets browser.pas" script uses this to let users extract a resource from a BSA/BA2.</summary>

declarations.declaration: function ResourceCount (asFilename: string; akContainers: TStrings): cardinal
declarations.doc: <summary>Fills akContainers with a list of the loaded containers (BSA, BA2, Data directory) that a file named asFilename appears in. The "Assets browser.pas" script uses this to allow users to decide which version of a file to view, when the file is overridden at least once within their load order.</summary>

declarations.name: ResourceExists
declarations.doc: <summary>Checks whether any loaded container has a file with the specified name.</summary>

declarations.name: ResourceList
declarations.doc: <summary>Accesses the container with the full filename asContainerName (see ResourceContainerList), and adds a list of all contained filenames to akContainers. Note that added entries are unsorted, and there may be duplicates among them.</summary>

declarations.name: ResourceOpenData
declarations.declaration: function ResourceOpenData (asContainerName: string; asFilename: string): TBytesStream
declarations.doc: <summary>asFilename should be formatted similar to the other Resource-oriented xEdit scripts. asContainerName should be filled with a string generated by the function ResourceContainerList. The ResourceOpenData function should only be used in conjunction with NifTextureList, as ResourceCopy removes any other need for this function.</summary>
